RELOCATION PROGRAM PLAN
AIRPORT SPUR (I-94 Interchange - South Howell Avenue)
The occupants of the proposed Airport Spur project were contacted recently to personally explain to them the relocation services program and payments provisions under existing law and proposed statutory changes for which they may be eligible. Simultaneously, pertinent data and information required for this plan was obtained relative to each displacee's needs, income, places of employment, family composition, etc.
Data was obtained from each of the 12 families or individuals that will be affected and each of the 5 businesses that will be displaced.
